title: Database migration + seed audit
environment: LINUX-CPU (postgres:16-alpine test harness via docker-compose postgres_test)

findings.detail: services/api/src/modules/training/routes.ts selects drill_checkpoint_map by (shot_type_id, checkpoint_definition_id) during every training-plan generation; the table's only index is the PK led by drill_id, forcing a full scan.

findings.area: unindexed FK columns on deletion cascade paths
findings.detail: final_hard_delete deletion task issues DELETE FROM app_user, cascading into shot/media_asset/analysis_job. Referencing FK columns without indexes (training_plan.source_shot_id/reassessment_shot_id, ml_dataset_item.source_shot_id/media_asset_id/feature_asset_id, session_summary.best_shot_id, weekly_report.best_shot_id, share_card.shot_id/session_id, shot.analysis_job_id/media_asset_id/feature_asset_id) cause per-row sequential scans during the cascade.

media_purge (worker.ts) selects media_asset by owner_user_id regardless of deleted_at, but the only owner index is partial on deleted_at IS NULL; idp_revoke counts deletion_task rows by user_id, which has no index.
findings.fix: migration 0016: idx_media_asset_owner_object_key (partial, object_key IS NOT NULL) and idx_deletion_task_user

findings.detail: 0015 consent_record satisfies C10: version (consent_version), timestamp (recorded_at + monotonic seq), withdrawal (append-only action='withdrawn' rows), audit trail (row-level UPDATE/DELETE trigger + audit_log entries, pseudonymous ledger survives account deletion). Gap: TRUNCATE bypasses row-level triggers, so the append-only guarantee could be bulk-erased.
findings.fix: migration 0016: statement-level BEFORE TRUNCATE trigger trg_consent_record_no_truncate

findings.area: seed data leaking into prod paths
findings.detail: seed.ts scoring_model upsert used ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET config unconditionally: re-running the seed against a database where a version had been released (status='active' with full 0013 release evidence) would overwrite the released config JSON with the pre-release hypothesis. Other seeds (shot_type, checkpoints, flags DO NOTHING, offerings, achievements) are deterministic catalog data intended for prod per directive §52 and are safe/idempotent; fixture drills are retired (active=false).
findings.fix: seed.ts: DO UPDATE ... WHERE scoring_model.status IN ('draft','validating'); released/retired models are skipped entirely (config, checkpoints, targets untouched). Regression test added.

findings.detail: Destructive migrations 0009 (deletes fixture-sourced shots, rebuilds progress_daily) and 0013 (quarantines evidence-less active models) each carry documented justification in their headers; runner (D-006) enforces checksums so applied files cannot be silently edited. No undocumented irreversible migration found. No fix needed.
